create_APG_guider: create an AdaptiveProjectedGuidance guider with custom guidance_scale and momentum parameters for diffusion sampling
build_momentum_buffer: build a MomentumBuffer with a momentum coefficient to track running averages of guidance differences across denoising steps
run_normalized_guidance: run normalized_guidance to apply adaptive projected guidance by projecting noise predictions onto orthogonal subspaces
configure_APG_with_rescale: configure AdaptiveProjectedGuidance with guidance_rescale to fix overexposure and improve image quality in diffusion generation
test_APG_enabled_range: test whether AdaptiveProjectedGuidance is enabled based on current denoising step within start/stop fraction range
